intentions.title: Give every media binary a single, tenant-correct JSON representation shared across all API surfaces
intentions.evidence: asset_response.ex's AssetResponse.render/3 merges a MediaFile blob row with its linked mediaAsset Document into one unified map (id, urls, mimeType, visibility, permissions, asset payload), consumed by both the scoped /w/:ws/p/:proj routes and legacy flat /media/* routes (legacy: true drops fields for backward compatibility).

intentions.title: Never leak private or field-restricted mediaAsset metadata to an unauthorized caller
intentions.evidence: asset_response.ex asset_payload/3 threads CallerContext through Envelope.render for the embedded mediaAsset document, with an anonymous fallback (caller_context/1) and comment describing the WS-B HIGH-2 fix: a nil/conn-less caller resolves to anonymous rather than 'full content', so redaction fails closed rather than leaking private/owner_only/readable_by fields.

intentions.title: Emit delivery URLs that are correct for the request's tenancy scope, signed when required, and CDN-fronted when configured
intentions.evidence: urls.ex builds original/thumbnail/preview/rendition URLs, prefixing with conn_scope_prefix (/w/:ws/p/:proj vs flat '') before signing (SignedUrl.sign) so a signed token verifies against the actually-requested path; maybe_sign only signs when the asset's visibility is 'token' (Access.visibility); cdn.ex's Cdn.public_url prefixes with the configured :media_cdn base_url when present, else passes through unchanged.

intentions.title: Keep CDN edge caches consistent with asset state via durable, retried invalidation and publish-status tracking
intentions.evidence: cdn.ex invalidate/1 purges original + all image rendition paths through invalidate_http, routed via Dispatcher.http_post to share webhook outbound policy; publish/2 patches the mediaAsset document's bp_cdn_status ('published'/'skipped') via Content.upsert_document so Studio/API consumers can see CDN state.

intentions.title: Guarantee media lifecycle webhooks (uploaded/processed/deleted) are delivered reliably even across crashes, using the same durable retry machinery as document webhooks
intentions.evidence: events.ex moduledoc describes convergence onto the shared durable-row retry state machine (webhook_deliveries, source_kind: 'media'): first attempt via Dispatcher.deliver_media/3, retries scheduled by RetryWorker (not Process.sleep), crash recovery via StuckDeliverySweeper rebuilding payload from the persisted snapshot since media's source event doesn't persist; degrades to a single best-effort signed/unsigned POST only if the durable row insert itself fails.

intentions.title: Provide fast, faceted, typo-tolerant media search that never crosses tenant boundaries even through the joined mediaAsset metadata
intentions.evidence: search.ex build_query/2 and retriever.ex build_text_filter/4 both scope the LEFT JOIN to mediaAsset documents by dataset_id + NULL-tolerant workspace/project envelope, with inline comments citing 'barkpark-vmv1' cross-workspace metadata leak fixes (both the Ecto join path and the raw-SQL tags_facet_sql path); supports facets (kind, mimeType, status, processing, collection, tags, visibility), relevance/created/updated sort, and cursor pagination.

intentions.title: Parse untrusted search query params defensively so malformed input degrades to safe defaults instead of 500ing
intentions.evidence: search_params.ex parse_facets/1 has a catch-all clause explicitly guarding against Phoenix parsing ?facets[]= or ?facets[k]=v into non-binary shapes that would otherwise raise FunctionClauseError; parse_int, blank_to_nil, and facet_selections merging (facet.* flat keys + nested facet map) all no-op safely on bad input.

intentions.title: Amortize per-request tenancy resolution cost across a single search's many sub-queries
intentions.evidence: search.ex search/2 resolves dataset string → dataset_id ONCE per request and threads it through opts[:dataset_id], with a comment noting this avoids ~9 redundant Tenancy.get_dataset/get_default_project roundtrips (7 facets + count + page) per search call.
